capabilities: Connect the vault to MCP-compatible AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor)
Sync notes incrementally to a cloud index using SHA-256 change detection
Answer natural-language questions over vault notes via semantic search
Exclude files from syncing with regex patterns
disambiguation: Not a search plugin for use inside Obsidian; the semantic search runs in external AI assistants via MCP.
extras: Freemium: free tier has 10MB storage and 100 MCP queries/day, Pro is $8/mo (yearly) or $12/mo. Notes are uploaded to an external cloud service (isolated per user). The listing carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' warning.
motivation: The README says AI assistants can't access your vault, and Obvec was built to bridge that gap.
problem: AI assistants cannot access the notes in an Obsidian vault, so users cannot ask questions about or search their own second brain from those tools.
